## Overview

Follow-up to #60895: run the routed experts of `DeepseekV2MoE` through #60895's block-FP8 DeepGEMM MegaMoE experts, for the DSA models (GLM-5.x, DeepSeek-V3.2: `GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM` / `DeepseekV32ForCausalLM` and their MTP). Enabled with `--moe-backend deep_gemm_mega_moe` (`--tensor-parallel-size 1 --enable-expert-parallel`, data parallel or prefill context parallel).

**Stacked on #60895**: only the last commit (`[Perf][GLM-5.x] DeepGEMM FP8 MegaMoE for DeepseekV2MoE (DSA models)`) is new here. Draft until #60895 lands; I'll rebase then.

## Changes

- `DeepseekV2MoE`: when the backend is `deep_gemm_mega_moe` and the caller allows it (`allow_mega_moe=True`, set by the DSA decoder layer), build `Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts` instead of `FusedMoE`:
  - routing (`scoring_func` + `e_score_correction_bias`, renormalized, times `routed_scaling_factor`) with `fused_topk_bias` before the kernel;
  - the shared expert stays a separate MLP (no shared-expert fusion yet);
  - requires EP, TP=1, one expert group, `noaux_tc` routing and a block-FP8 checkpoint; other configurations raise `NotImplementedError`.
- DSA model and MTP: expert weights load into the kernel layout (`routed_experts_prefix=""`), `process_weights_after_loading` requantizes them (UE8M0 1x32), and layerwise reload is refused until #57733, as in #60895.
- Other backends and other `DeepseekV2MoE` users are unchanged; DeepSeek-V2/V3 with this backend get a clear error.

**Prefill context parallelism** needs no extra handling: MegaMoE is a collective over the EP group, and with PCP every EP rank runs each MoE layer once per step on the same padded token count, so the kernel calls stay matched.

## Validation

Measured with a prototype of the same integration on vLLM v0.31.0 (same routing, same requantization rounding as #60895, shared expert outside the kernel), GLM-5.3 FP8, one 8x B300 node, PCP8 x EP8, MTP 1. Same pod and identical prompts; only the MoE differs:

| | FlashInfer TRT-LLM | MegaMoE |
|---|---:|---:|
| GSM8K, 1,319, greedy, chat | 96.36% | 96.59% |
| Long-context retrieval, 5 depths, 32k / 64k / 128k / 187k tokens | 20/20 | 20/20 |
| Cold prefill, 16k prompts, 8 / 24 in flight | 54.0k / 55.9k tok/s | 85.8k / 90.8k tok/s (+59% / +62%) |

GSM8K: 7 questions right only with TRT-LLM, 10 only with MegaMoE (McNemar p = 0.63).

Not yet run on this branch itself (main + #60895 + this commit): I'll repeat the same checks on B300 and post them here before marking it ready. `tests/models/deepseek_v32/test_mega_moe_wiring.py` covers the loader helpers on CPU.

Added 709aa811e7: the MegaMoE path now also takes ModelOpt NVFP4 experts (`nvfp4_mega_moe`, loaded straight into the kernel layout) and unquantized experts (`bf16_mega_moe`, e.g. the BF16 MTP layer of `nvidia/GLM-5.3-NVFP4`). Block-FP8 experts keep the requantizing path.

Ran it on 8×B300 (SM103) with `nvidia/GLM-5.3-NVFP4`, on main @ 2de0531 plus this PR. The setup: PCP8 + EP prefill, MTP 1, `PIECEWISE` prefill graphs (needs #63208), block size 256, no KV connector. It loads and serves. Prefill numbers against this PR's FP8 path on the same build:

| | FP8 MegaMoE | NVFP4 MegaMoE |
|---|---|---|
| cold 2k / 4k / 16k / 64k | 91 / 69 / 182 / 710 ms | 77 / 70 / 181 / 708 ms |
| 16k prompts × 24 in flight | 101.9k tok/s | 101.9k tok/s |

Prefill is effectively the same; I'd expect any NVFP4 gain on decode, where expert weight bandwidth dominates. Decode numbers and accuracy evals (GSM8K, needle) for the NVFP4 path are still pending, so the PR stays a draft until those are in.
Reverted the NVFP4/BF16 commit again (709aa811e7); this PR stays scoped to block-FP8 experts. The PCP draft-prefill fix is separate in #63208.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""DeepseekV2MoE MegaMoE wiring helpers (no GPU needed)."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.model_executor.models import deepseek_v2
+from vllm.model_executor.models.deepseek_v2 import (
+    finalize_mega_moe_weights,
+    mega_moe_routed_experts_prefix,
+)
+
+
+class _FakeMoE(deepseek_v2.DeepseekV2MoE):
+    """A DeepseekV2MoE without __init__: only the attributes the helpers read."""
+
+    def __init__(self, use_mega_moe: bool):
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        self.use_mega_moe = use_mega_moe
+        self.requantized = 0
+        self.experts = SimpleNamespace(requantize_block_fp8=self._requantize)
+
+    def _requantize(self):
+        self.requantized += 1
+
+
+def test_routed_experts_prefix_is_empty_for_mega_moe():
+    dense = nn.Identity()
+    assert mega_moe_routed_experts_prefix([dense, _FakeMoE(False)]) == "routed_experts"
+    assert mega_moe_routed_experts_prefix([dense, _FakeMoE(True)]) == ""
+    assert mega_moe_routed_experts_prefix(iter([_FakeMoE(True)])) == ""
+
+
+def test_finalize_requantizes_mega_moe_layers_only():
+    mega, fused = _FakeMoE(True), _FakeMoE(False)
+    finalize_mega_moe_weights([mega, fused, nn.Identity()])
+    assert mega.requantized == 1
+    assert fused.requantized == 0

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""GLM-5.3-Flash MegaMoE: block-FP8 checkpoint shards requantized to the
+MXFP8 MegaMoE kernel layout."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.deep_gemm_mega_moe import (
+    DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts,
+    MegaMoEActivation,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.reload import (
+    finalize_layerwise_reload,
+    initialize_layerwise_reload,
+    record_metadata_for_reloading,
+)
+from vllm.models.glm5next.nvidia.mega_moe import (
+    Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts,
+    requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0,
+)
+
+BLOCK = (128, 128)
+HIDDEN, INTER = 256, 128
+FP8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+# Global ids of the experts _experts() places on this rank.
+LOCAL_EXPERTS = slice(2, 4)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def sm100_mega_moe_layout(monkeypatch):
+    """Build the SM100 kernel layout on any device."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.deep_gemm_mega_moe."
+        "check_deep_gemm_mega_moe_supported",
+        lambda *args: None,
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts, "_kernel_fuses_shared_experts", lambda self, spec: True
+    )
+
+
+def _block_fp8(real: torch.Tensor, power_of_two: bool = False):
+    """Quantize ``(..., mn, k)`` to E4M3 with one float32 scale per 128x128."""
+    *lead, mn, k = real.shape
+    blocks = real.reshape(*lead, mn // 128, 128, k // 128, 128)
+    scale = blocks.abs().amax(dim=(-3, -1)) / 448.0
+    if power_of_two:
+        scale = torch.exp2(torch.ceil(torch.log2(scale)))
+    full = scale.repeat_interleave(128, -2).repeat_interleave(128, -1)
+    return (real / full).to(FP8), scale
+
+
+def _dequant_block(weight: torch.Tensor, scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return weight.float() * scale.repeat_interleave(128, -2).repeat_interleave(128, -1)
+
+
+def _dequant_ue8m0(weight: torch.Tensor, sf: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return weight.float() * torch.exp2(sf.float() - 127).repeat_interleave(32, -1)
+
+
+def test_requant_gives_power_of_two_scale_per_32_columns():
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    real = torch.randn(3, 256, 384) * 0.02
+    weight, scale = _block_fp8(real)
+
+    requant, sf = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(weight, scale)
+
+    assert requant.dtype == FP8
+    assert requant.shape == weight.shape
+    assert sf.dtype == torch.uint8
+    assert sf.shape == (3, 256, 384 // 32)
+    assert requant.float().abs().max() <= 448.0
+    original = _dequant_block(weight, scale)
+    restored = _dequant_ue8m0(requant, sf)
+    # One more E4M3 rounding of every element: a few percent, never garbage.
+    rel = ((restored - original).norm() / original.norm()).item()
+    assert 0 < rel < 0.05
+
+
+def test_requant_is_exact_for_power_of_two_block_scales():
+    torch.manual_seed(1)
+    real = torch.randn(1, 256, 256) * 0.05
+    weight, scale = _block_fp8(real, power_of_two=True)
+
+    requant, sf = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(weight, scale)
+
+    # A finer power-of-two scale only shifts exponents, so nothing rounds.
+    assert torch.equal(_dequant_ue8m0(requant, sf), _dequant_block(weight, scale))
+
+
+def _shared_mlp(shared_size: int):
+    def linear(n, k):
+        return SimpleNamespace(
+            weight=torch.empty(n, k, dtype=FP8),
+            weight_scale_inv=torch.empty(n // BLOCK[0], k // BLOCK[1]),
+        )
+
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        gate_up_proj=linear(2 * shared_size, HIDDEN),
+        down_proj=linear(HIDDEN, shared_size),
+    )
+
+
+def _experts(**kwargs) -> Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts:
+    vllm_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(max_num_batched_tokens=64),
+        compilation_config=SimpleNamespace(static_forward_context={}),
+    )
+    kwargs.setdefault("shared_experts", _shared_mlp(INTER))
+    return Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts(
+        vllm_config,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+        num_experts=4,
+        num_local_experts=2,
+        experts_start_idx=2,
+        top_k=2,
+        hidden_size=HIDDEN,
+        intermediate_size=INTER,
+        weight_block_size=BLOCK,
+        activation=MegaMoEActivation("swiglu", clamp=10.0),
+        prefix="model.layers.3.mlp.experts",
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+def _checkpoint(num_experts: int, seed: int) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Block-FP8 experts as stored: gate rows, then up rows, for w13."""
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+
+    def rand(*shape):
+        return torch.randn(*shape, generator=generator) * 0.02
+
+    w13, s13 = _block_fp8(rand(num_experts, 2 * INTER, HIDDEN))
+    w2, s2 = _block_fp8(rand(num_experts, HIDDEN, INTER))
+    return {
+        "w13_weight": w13,
+        "w13_weight_scale_inv": s13,
+        "w2_weight": w2,
+        "w2_weight_scale_inv": s2,
+    }
+
+
+def _load_shuffled(experts, ckpt, seed, suffix="") -> None:
+    """Load the checkpoint tensors whose names end in ``suffix``, shuffled."""
+    shards = []
+    for expert_id in range(ckpt["w13_weight"].shape[0]):
+        for name, tensor in ckpt.items():
+            if not name.endswith(suffix):
+                continue
+            if name.startswith("w2_"):
+                shards.append((name, tensor[expert_id], "w2", expert_id))
+            else:
+                half = tensor.shape[1] // 2
+                shards.append((name, tensor[expert_id, :half], "w1", expert_id))
+                shards.append((name, tensor[expert_id, half:], "w3", expert_id))
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    for i in torch.randperm(len(shards), generator=generator).tolist():
+        name, loaded_weight, shard_id, expert_id = shards[i]
+        param = getattr(experts, name)
+        loaded = param.weight_loader(
+            param,
+            loaded_weight,
+            f"experts.{name}",
+            shard_id=shard_id,
+            expert_id=expert_id,
+            return_success=True,
+        )
+        # Physical experts 2 and 3 are this rank's.
+        assert loaded == (expert_id >= 2)
+
+
+def _reference_mega_moe_layout(w13, s13, w2, s2):
+    """CPU copy of DeepGEMM's transform_weights_for_mega_moe on packed scales."""
+
+    def interleave(t):
+        g, n, k = t.shape
+        halves = t.view(g, 2, n // 16, 8, k)
+        return torch.stack([halves[:, 0], halves[:, 1]], dim=2).reshape(g, n, k)
+
+    def utccp(sf):
+        g, mn, k = sf.shape
+        return sf.reshape(g, -1, 4, 32, k).transpose(2, 3).reshape(g, mn, k)
+
+    return (
+        interleave(w13.view(torch.uint8)),
+        utccp(interleave(s13.view(torch.int32))),
+        w2.view(torch.uint8),
+        utccp(s2.view(torch.int32)),
+    )
+
+
+def _expected_routed(ckpt):
+    local = LOCAL_EXPERTS
+    w13, s13 = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(
+        ckpt["w13_weight"][local], ckpt["w13_weight_scale_inv"][local]
+    )
+    w2, s2 = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(
+        ckpt["w2_weight"][local], ckpt["w2_weight_scale_inv"][local]
+    )
+    return _reference_mega_moe_layout(w13, s13, w2, s2)
+
+
+def _assert_layout(actual, expected):
+    for tensor, reference in zip(actual, expected):
+        assert torch.equal(tensor.view(reference.dtype), reference)
+
+
+def _routed(experts):
+    return (*experts.l1_weights, *experts.l2_weights)
+
+
+def test_block_fp8_shards_requantize_into_the_kernel_layout():
+    experts = _experts()
+    ckpt = _checkpoint(4, seed=0)
+    _load_shuffled(experts, ckpt, seed=0)
+    assert torch.equal(experts.w13_weight_scale_inv, ckpt["w13_weight_scale_inv"][2:])
+
+    experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+
+    expected = _expected_routed(ckpt)
+    _assert_layout(_routed(experts), expected)
+    # Already requantized shards are left alone by a second call.
+    experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+    _assert_layout(_routed(experts), expected)
+    # A reload writes raw block-FP8 values again and requantizes them in place.
+    ptr = experts.w13_weight.data_ptr()
+    ckpt = _checkpoint(4, seed=1)
+    _load_shuffled(experts, ckpt, seed=1)
+    experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+    assert experts.w13_weight.data_ptr() == ptr
+    _assert_layout(_routed(experts), _expected_routed(ckpt))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("first", ["weight", "weight_scale_inv"])
+def test_weight_update_split_across_calls(first):
+    """A weight update may send weights and block scales in separate
+    load_weights calls. The finish step rejects a shard still missing its
+    other half and requantizes each shard once both are in."""
+    experts = _experts()
+    _load_shuffled(experts, _checkpoint(4, seed=0), seed=0)
+    experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+
+    ckpt = _checkpoint(4, seed=1)
+    second = "weight_scale_inv" if first == "weight" else "weight"
+    _load_shuffled(experts, ckpt, seed=1, suffix=first)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="without their weight or block scale"):
+        experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+    _load_shuffled(experts, ckpt, seed=2, suffix=second)
+    experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+
+    _assert_layout(_routed(experts), _expected_routed(ckpt))
+
+
+def _shared_checkpoint(seed: int) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
+    w13, s13 = _block_fp8(torch.randn(1, 2 * INTER, HIDDEN, generator=generator) * 0.02)
+    w2, s2 = _block_fp8(torch.randn(1, HIDDEN, INTER, generator=generator) * 0.02)
+    return {"w13": w13, "s13": s13, "w2": w2, "s2": s2}
+
+
+def _load_shared(experts, ckpt) -> None:
+    w13, s13, w2, s2 = ckpt["w13"], ckpt["s13"], ckpt["w2"], ckpt["s2"]
+    params = {f"mlp.experts.{n}" for n, _ in experts.named_parameters()}
+    for name, data in [
+        ("down_proj.weight_scale_inv", s2[0]),
+        ("gate_proj.weight", w13[0, :INTER]),
+        ("up_proj.weight_scale_inv", s13[0, 1:]),
+        ("down_proj.weight", w2[0]),
+        ("up_proj.weight", w13[0, INTER:]),
+        ("gate_proj.weight_scale_inv", s13[0, :1]),
+    ]:
+        loaded = experts.load_shared_expert_weight(f"mlp.shared_experts.{name}", data)
+        assert loaded in params
+
+
+def _expected_shared(ckpt):
+    q13, sf13 = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(ckpt["w13"], ckpt["s13"])
+    q2, sf2 = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(ckpt["w2"], ckpt["s2"])
+    return [t[0] for t in _reference_mega_moe_layout(q13, sf13, q2, sf2)]
+
+
+def _shared(experts):
+    return (
+        experts.shared_l1_weight,
+        experts.shared_l1_weight_scale,
+        experts.shared_l2_weight,
+        experts.shared_l2_weight_scale,
+    )
+
+
+def test_block_fp8_shared_expert_is_fused_and_requantized():
+    experts = _experts()
+    assert experts.has_fused_shared_experts
+    ckpt = _shared_checkpoint(seed=0)
+    _load_shared(experts, ckpt)
+
+    experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+
+    _assert_layout(_shared(experts), _expected_shared(ckpt))
+
+
+def test_layerwise_reload_requantizes_into_the_kernel_tensors():
+    """Reload and weight transfer restore the layer on meta, buffer every load,
+    replay it once the layer is complete and finish with the model's
+    process_weights_after_loading; the kernel tensors keep their storage."""
+    experts = _experts()
+    record_metadata_for_reloading(experts)
+    _load_shuffled(experts, _checkpoint(4, seed=0), seed=0)
+    _load_shared(experts, _shared_checkpoint(seed=0))
+    experts.requantize_block_fp8()
+    storage = {n: p.data_ptr() for n, p in experts.named_parameters()}
+
+    ckpt, shared_ckpt = _checkpoint(4, seed=1), _shared_checkpoint(seed=1)
+    initialize_layerwise_reload(experts)
+    _load_shuffled(experts, ckpt, seed=1)
+    _load_shared(experts, shared_ckpt)
+    # Every loaded tensor is in, so the layer was replayed without waiting for
+    # finalize: the derived kernel scales do not count as missing loads.
+    assert not experts.w13_weight.is_meta
+    finalize_layerwise_reload(experts, None)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""GLM-5.3-Flash adapter for the DeepGEMM MegaMoE kernel."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.deep_gemm_mega_moe import (
+    MEGA_MOE_MXFP8,
+    DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts,
+    MegaMoEWeightSpec,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+    _mxfp8_e4m3_quantize_torch,
+)
+
+# (local expert id, shard id); the fused shared expert has expert id None.
+Shard = tuple[int | None, str]
+
+
+def requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(
+    weight: torch.Tensor, scale: torch.Tensor
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Requantize block-FP8 weights to E4M3 with one UE8M0 scale per 1x32.
+
+    The SM100 MegaMoE feeds its scales to the block-scaled MMA, so they have to
+    be powers of two, one per row and 32 columns. A checkpoint with float32
+    scales per block (e.g. 128x128) is rounded once more to get there.
+
+    Args:
+        weight: ``(n, mn, k)`` E4M3 values.
+        scale: ``(n, mn / block_m, k / block_k)`` float32 dequantization
+            scales (``real = weight * scale``).
+
+    Returns:
+        ``(weight, sf)``: the requantized E4M3 weights and their UE8M0 scale
+        bytes, ``(n, mn, k / 32)`` uint8.
+
+    """
+    assert weight.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn, weight.dtype
+    assert scale.dtype == torch.float32, scale.dtype
+    n, mn, k = weight.shape
+    _, blocks_m, blocks_k = scale.shape
+    assert scale.shape[0] == n and mn % blocks_m == 0 and k % blocks_k == 0, (
+        tuple(weight.shape),
+        tuple(scale.shape),
+    )
+    real = weight.to(torch.float32).view(n, blocks_m, -1, blocks_k, k // blocks_k)
+    real.mul_(scale[:, :, None, :, None])
+    return _mxfp8_e4m3_quantize_torch(real.view(n, mn, k))
+
+
+class Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts(DeepGemmMegaMoEExperts):
+    """MXFP8 MegaMoE experts loaded from GLM-5.3-Flash's block-FP8 checkpoint.
+
+    The checkpoint stores E4M3 weights with one float32 scale per
+    ``weight_block_size`` block; the kernel takes power-of-two UE8M0 scales per
+    1x32. Loading writes each weight shard straight into the kernel layout and
+    stages its block scale in ``*_weight_scale_inv``. Once a load is complete,
+    the model's ``process_weights_after_loading`` calls
+    :meth:`requantize_block_fp8`, which rounds every newly loaded shard to the
+    kernel scales in place. A block-FP8 shared expert is fused the same way.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        *,
+        weight_block_size: tuple[int, int],
+        **kwargs,
+    ):
+        block_m, block_k = weight_block_size
+        self.weight_block_size = (block_m, block_k)
+        # Shards whose weight / block scale arrived since the last requantize.
+        self._new_weights: set[Shard] = set()
+        self._new_scales: set[Shard] = set()
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, weight_format=MEGA_MOE_MXFP8, **kwargs)
+        h, i = self.hidden_size, self.intermediate_size
+        if h % block_m or h % block_k or i % block_m or i % block_k:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "GLM-5.3 MegaMoE requires hidden and intermediate sizes that are "
+                f"multiples of the FP8 block size {self.weight_block_size}."
+            )
+
+    def _shared_linear_fits(self, linear: nn.Module, spec: MegaMoEWeightSpec) -> bool:
+        """A block-FP8 linear loads into the routed MXFP8 layout by requantizing."""
+        weight = linear.weight
+        scale = getattr(linear, "weight_scale_inv", None)
+        if spec != self.weight_format.routed or weight.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn:
+            return False
+        if weight.dim() != 2 or scale is None or scale.dtype != torch.float32:
+            return False
+        (rows, cols), (block_m, block_k) = weight.shape, self.weight_block_size
+        return tuple(scale.shape) == (rows // block_m, cols // block_k)
+
+    def _create_weights(self) -> None:
+        super()._create_weights()
+        e, h, i = self.num_local_experts, self.hidden_size, self.intermediate_size
+        self._register_block_scale("w13", (e, 2 * i, h))
+        self._register_block_scale("w2", (e, h, i))
+        if self.has_fused_shared_experts:
+            s = i * self.num_shared_experts
+            self._register_block_scale("shared_l1", (2 * s, h))
+            self._register_block_scale("shared_l2", (h, s))
+
+    def _register_block_scale(self, name: str, shape: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
+        """Stage the checkpoint's float32 block scales of ``name``. The kernel's
+        ``{name}_weight_scale`` is derived from them and never loaded."""
+        *outer, n, k = shape
+        block_m, block_k = self.weight_block_size
+        scale = torch.zeros(*outer, n // block_m, k // block_k, dtype=torch.float32)
+        self.register_parameter(
+            f"{name}_weight_scale_inv", nn.Parameter(scale, requires_grad=False)
+        )
+        getattr(self, f"{name}_weight_scale").weight_loader_numel = 0
+
+    def weight_loader(
+        self,
+        param: nn.Parameter,
+        loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        weight_name: str,
+        shard_id: str,
+        expert_id: int,
+        return_success: bool = False,
+    ) -> bool | None:
+        local_expert_ids = self._map_global_expert_id(expert_id)
+        if weight_name.endswith("weight_scale_inv"):
+            param_prefix = "w2_" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13_"
+            loaded = bool(local_expert_ids) and param_prefix in weight_name
+            for local_expert_id in local_expert_ids if loaded else ():
+                self._stage_block_scale(
+                    param.data[local_expert_id], loaded_weight, shard_id
+                )
+            new = self._new_scales
+        else:
+            loaded = bool(
+                super().weight_loader(
+                    param,
+                    loaded_weight,
+                    weight_name,
+                    shard_id,
+                    expert_id,
+                    return_success=True,
+                )
+            )
+            new = self._new_weights
+        if loaded:
+            new.update(
+                (local_expert_id, shard_id) for local_expert_id in local_expert_ids
+            )
+        return loaded if return_success else None
+
+    def _shared_param_name(self, name: str) -> str:
+        param_name = super()._shared_param_name(name)
+        # Block scales go to the staging parameter, not the kernel scale.
+        return param_name + "_inv" if param_name.endswith("_scale") else param_name
+
+    def shared_weight_loader(
+        self, param: nn.Parameter, loaded_weight: torch.Tensor, weight_name: str
+    ) -> None:
+        shard_id = self._shared_shard_id(weight_name)
+        if "weight_scale" in weight_name:
+            self._stage_block_scale(param.data, loaded_weight, shard_id)
+            self._new_scales.add((None, shard_id))
+        else:
+            super().shared_weight_loader(param, loaded_weight, weight_name)
+            self._new_weights.add((None, shard_id))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _shard_rows(t: torch.Tensor, shard_id: str) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Rows of ``t`` (gate rows, then up rows, for w13) that hold ``shard_id``."""
+        if shard_id == "w2":
+            return t
+        half = t.shape[0] // 2
+        return t[:half] if shard_id == "w1" else t[half:]
+
+    def _stage_block_scale(
+        self, dst: torch.Tensor, src: torch.Tensor, shard_id: str
+    ) -> None:
+        dst = self._shard_rows(dst, shard_id)
+        if tuple(src.shape) != tuple(dst.shape):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.prefix}: {shard_id} block scale shape {tuple(src.shape)} "
+                f"does not match {tuple(dst.shape)} for FP8 blocks "
+                f"{self.weight_block_size}"
+            )
+        dst.copy_(src)
+
+    @torch.no_grad()
+    def requantize_block_fp8(self, chunk: int = 8) -> None:
+        """Round every shard loaded since the last call to UE8M0 1x32 scales,
+        in place.
+
+        Runs once a load is complete. A weight update may send a weight and its
+        block scale in separate ``load_weights`` calls, but both have to be in
+        by then.
+        """
+        unpaired = self._new_weights ^ self._new_scales
+        if unpaired:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.prefix}: block-FP8 shards (local expert, shard; None is "
+                "the shared expert) loaded without their weight or block scale: "
+                f"{sorted(unpaired, key=str)}"
+            )
+        for shard_id in ("w1", "w3", "w2"):
+            experts = sorted(
+                e for e, s in self._new_weights if s == shard_id and e is not None
+            )
+            for start in range(0, len(experts), chunk):
+                self._requantize_shards(
+                    [
+                        self._shard_tensors(e, shard_id)
+                        for e in experts[start : start + chunk]
+                    ],
+                    shard_id,
+                )
+            if (None, shard_id) in self._new_weights:
+                self._requantize_shards([self._shard_tensors(None, shard_id)], shard_id)
+        self._new_weights.clear()
+        self._new_scales.clear()
+
+    def _shard_tensors(
+        self, local_expert_id: int | None, shard_id: str
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]:
+        """Kernel weight, kernel scale and staged block scale of one routed
+        expert, or of the shared expert for ``local_expert_id`` None."""
+        if local_expert_id is None:
+            name = "shared_l2" if shard_id == "w2" else "shared_l1"
+        else:
+            name = "w2" if shard_id == "w2" else "w13"
+        tensors = tuple(
+            getattr(self, f"{name}_{suffix}").data
+            for suffix in ("weight", "weight_scale", "weight_scale_inv")
+        )
+        if local_expert_id is None:
+            return tensors
+        return tuple(t[local_expert_id] for t in tensors)
+
+    def _requantize_shards(
+        self, tensors: list[tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]], shard_id: str
+    ) -> None:
+        """Requantize ``shard_id`` of each kernel-layout weight in place."""
+        raw = torch.stack(
+            [
+                self._weight_shard_view(w, shard_id).reshape(-1, w.shape[-1])
+                for w, _, _ in tensors
+            ]
+        )
+        block_scale = torch.stack(
+            [self._shard_rows(s, shard_id) for _, _, s in tensors]
+        )
+        weight, sf = requant_block_fp8_to_ue8m0(raw, block_scale)
+        for (dst, dst_scale, _), w, s in zip(tensors, weight, sf):
+            self._load_weight(dst, w, shard_id, False)
+            self._load_weight(dst_scale, s, shard_id, True)
+
+
+Glm5NextMegaMoEExperts.weight_loader.supports_moe_loading = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

Ran it on 8×B300 (SM103) with `nvidia/GLM-5.3-NVFP4`, on main @ 2de0531 plus this PR. The setup: PCP8 + EP prefill, MTP 1, `PIECEWISE` prefill graphs (needs #63208), block size 256, no KV connector. It loads and serves. Prefill numbers against this PR's FP8 path on the same build:

| | FP8 MegaMoE | NVFP4 MegaMoE |

| cold 2k / 4k / 16k / 64k | 91 / 69 / 182 / 710 ms | 77 / 70 / 181 / 708 ms |
| 16k prompts × 24 in flight | 101.9k tok/s | 101.9k tok/s |

Prefill is effectively the same; I'd expect any NVFP4 gain on decode, where expert weight bandwidth dominates. Decode numbers and accuracy evals (GSM8K, needle) for the NVFP4 path are still pending, so the PR stays a draft until those are in.
